observations: Six completed quest prerequisites and base level 50 Magic are required to start; Thieving 53, boostable Firemaking 50 and respiratory protection gate later steps.
Eblis takes 12 magic logs, 6 steel bars, 6 molten glass, ashes, charcoal, blood rune and bones after the Bandit Camp bartender's 650 GP drink.
The four diamonds may be earned independently after Eblis's mirrors. The Ancient Pyramid accepts each exactly once, then unlocks entry when all four are placed.
Smoke route lights four torches quickly, opens the warm-key chest and defeats Fareed using water spells as a modeled alternative to the ice gloves weapon path.
Shadow route returns a gilded cross to Rasolo for a ring of visibility before defeating both of Damis's phases.
Ice route uses Dunstan's untradeable spiked boots and two fire spells to free the troll parents after fighting Kamil.
Blood route has Ruantun make a silver pot, Entrana priest bless it, Malak fill it for 5 HP, then garlic powder and spice added before the Dessous ritual.
Quest completion yields 3 quest points, 20,000 fixed Magic XP and Ancient Magicks; separately claimable Eblis staff and signet are not included in completion.
Stage times are broad estimates; combat loot, HP costs, consumed spell runes and travel detours require game replay.

Check precise cave entry/exits and Ice Path plane transitions; some tiled underground routes are approximate.
Lockpicking has stochastic pick breakage; budget 20 consumed of 40 acquired; adjust to current mechanics.
Verify four smoke torches fit the actual time limit with the route and world movement speeds.
Combat reserves for Fareed, Damis, Kamil and Dessous and exact incidental spell/combat XP are not yet determined.
Respiratory gear must be worn; the inventory token models possession and Slayer requirement but not equipment-slot state.
Optional alternative to toxic smoke is gas mask from Plague City, which needs an upstream producer.
Ancient Pyramid navigation can force the player out; modeled as a successful route with time estimate.
The source declares 6.9 mandatory incidental Magic XP beyond the fixed 20,000; not included in fixed reward.
